title: SG-8.5 Unit tests for ContributionSheet with the API client mocked
summary: Contribution modal behaviours are proven by passing unit tests with the API mocked
description: Context: ContributionSheet (game/frontend/src/components/ContributionSheet.tsx) already implements submit, history, validation and Radix dialog focus behaviour, with many partial suites in game/frontend/tests. Desired behavior: four focused test files exist and pass, covering submit success, API error, quota exhausted, history loading/empty/error/list, empty and over-length validation, Escape, focus trap and focus restore. Expected result: each behaviour is asserted by a named test. Why: SG-8.5 requires the test files to actually exist and pass.
acceptance_criteria: Given the API is mocked, when a submit succeeds, fails with 500 or fails with 409, then each outcome is asserted by a test that passes
Given the history endpoint is mocked, when it is pending, empty, failing or returns entries, then each state is asserted by a test that passes
Given empty and 501-character text, when Send is attempted, then the validation tests assert no POST is made
Given an open dialog, when Escape is pressed, focus moves outside or the dialog closes, then the Escape, focus trap and focus restore tests pass

in_scope: Test ids on existing ContributionSheet elements
Four new vitest files under game/frontend/tests

technical_constraints: vitest with jsdom and mocked fetch
definition_of_done: All four new test files pass
